biography:
In summary, I have experience with relevant interventions in a wide range of leadership in thematic issues, ranging from developing and financing tech startups, environmental science, renewable energy, and climate finance to democratic governance.

Faisal has a BCSE (Hons) from Latrobe University, an MSc from the London School of Economics and Political Science, and a PhD from Universitas Indonesia.

Specialities: tech startup, blockchain technology, cryptocurrencies, fintech, climate change policy, infrastructure development, democratic governance, sales and marketing, CDM, renewable energy, carbon finance, REDD+, trust fund, ICT for Development, ASEAN Region. Project Management, Programme Planning and Management, Monitoring and Evaluation, Advisory Services

Faisal is a recreational endurance athlete who competed in several Ironman 70.3 distances.
